name: typed-public
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library.log" 2>&1; bun lean-kernel/lift-typed/public-test.ts > "$OUT/public.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake env lean TypedControls.lean > "$OUT/typed-controls.log" 2>&1; lake env lean FullRoleControl.lean > "$OUT/full-role-control.log" 2>&1; printf "PUBLIC_CLI_AND_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS_CHECKED\n" > "$OUT/SUCCESS.txt"
